title: vinzdg/codenotch
why_read: A small utility app addressing a real annoyance for developers who juggle multiple AI coding tools with separate usage caps, useful but not deeply novel engineering.
analysis: Codenotch is a macOS menu-bar style app that displays usage limits from multiple AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity pinned to a screen edge. This is a practical convenience tool addressing the real pain point of tracking rate limits across several paid AI subscriptions simultaneously. It's not technically groundbreaking, but it reflects a growing niche of tooling built around managing AI-assisted developer workflows. Its popularity suggests genuine utility for developers who use multiple LLM coding tools daily.
